name: Kettlebell Suitcase Carry
steps: Stand beside a heavy kettlebell, hinge down with a flat back, and lift it to standing in one hand at your side.
Brace your core, level your shoulders, and pack your loaded shoulder blade back and down.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps while resisting any side lean toward or away from the kettlebell.
Set the bell down safely with a hip hinge after covering the target distance, then switch hands.
tips: Keep both shoulders and hips completely level as if carrying an equal weight in each hand.
Walk slowly and deliberately rather than rushing so your obliques stabilize every stride.
